The Greeks further proposed theories regarding the relationship between the moon and the Earth. By what means is it that the same face of the moon is always visible from Earth? [0] The far side of the moon does not reflect sunlight. [1] The moon stays in one location while Earth revolves around it. [2] The period of rotation and the period of revolution for the moon are about the same. [3] The moon rotates clockwise on its axis while Earth rotates counterclockwise on its axis.
